name: DataXAPI: alert when comments mention a keyword

parameters.content:
## Comment keyword alert
Every hour, reads the latest page of comments under each post in **Posts to watch**, and sends new comments containing any of your keywords to a webhook.

**Cost:** 1 DataXAPI call per post per run; 2 posts hourly is 48 calls a day. Prices differ by platform: see each endpoint page at https://dataxapi.com/apis/
